shared_elements: schematic figure with radiating/splayed limbs (A) vs. splayed-limbed creatures in relief (B)
linear, reduced rendering of a living form
justification: A shows a single faint, isolated figure with radiating limbs on an open rock face, with no companions, registers or attributes; B shows a densely populated, register-organised composition with a row of arched motifs, a fringed band, quadrupeds, birds and a serpentine form in relief. Beyond the trivial fact that both depict limbed living forms in reduced outline, there is no shared motif, relationship or layout.
